description: Every update is a pull request that merges itself once its release is old enough and the build and lint checks pass. main accepts only squash merges of signed commits, so Renovate commits through GitHub's API, which signs them.

customManagers.description: Images pinned by tag and digest, as quoted strings, in the workflows and scripts.
Release versions pinned as build arguments in the Containerfiles, each named by the renovate comment above it.

packageRules.description: Hermes releases are tagged vYYYY.M.D (sometimes with a fourth part). A new release merges itself one day after it is published: Hermes quarantines its own dependencies, and the day covers a compromised release, which is usually caught within hours.
signal-cli must stay current because Signal retires old clients. GHCR gives Renovate no release dates, so a new release merges itself without a wait.
The distroless base is resolved to its current digest at each build, so it is not pinned here.

Debian images: the SSH sandbox's base, and the stage that fetches tirith for the Hermes image. Debian's updates already reach the sandbox daily through apt-get upgrade, and the tirith stage keeps nothing from its base, so a new debian:13-slim build merges itself once it is at least seven days old.

Tools the workflows and scripts run (Trivy, actionlint, ShellCheck and the Debian image for the daily check) do not end up in the published images, so they merge themselves once a release is at least seven days old. Docker Hub's push date counts as the release date, so a re-pushed tag restarts the wait.

tirith, the command scanner in the Hermes image, is pinned to a release whose signature the build verifies. A new release merges itself once it is at least seven days old, which covers a compromised release that its own signing pipeline published. Its threat database is not pinned: tirith refreshes it on the data volume.
Cosign, which verifies tirith's signature while the Hermes image is built and does not end up in it, merges itself once a release is at least seven days old.
Pinned GitHub Actions merge themselves once a release is at least seven days old.
